title.zh: DeFi hack attack: Three exploits snatch $11M in a single day
title.en: DeFi hack attack: Three exploits snatch $11M in a single day

current_state.zh: Three DeFi projects — Payy Network, Duelbits, and Meter — were exploited on the same day for a combined loss of more than $11 million, with Payy's Ethereum bridge completely drained and its operations paused.
